metadata.description: OpenSpec-Superpowers bridge plugin — strong validation via deterministic checks + Git Hooks + dual verification.

plugins.name: sdd-tdd-bridge
plugins.description: OpenSpec-Superpowers bridge: main Agent orchestrates 6 stage Skills (explore / proposal / load-context / planning / spec-compliance-check / dual-verify), deterministic checks for OpenSpec artifact format (openspec-format-check), Git Hooks for commit message (commit-msg-check), dual verification (OpenSpec verify + Superpowers verification) before archive. Connects OpenSpec (what to do) with Superpowers (how to do) with strong validation.
